# v3.4.4 — GCP Project Pagination Fix & Security Updates

Customers with more than 1000 GCP projects will now see all of them in the project selector. Earlier releases silently capped at 1000 due to a missing pagination loop. This release also bundles security patches for the Go and frontend dependency tree, and consolidates the release pipeline onto GitLab.

> **Note:** v3.4.3 binaries were not published due to a GitHub Actions runner outage during the release cut. v3.4.4 supersedes it and includes every v3.4.3 fix plus additional security updates.

## Bug Fixes

### GCP — Project Selector
- **Project listing now paginates correctly** — the ADC, Browser OAuth, and Workload Identity Federation validators previously called Cloud Resource Manager v1 `projects.list` once and decoded only the first response page, silently capping at the v1 per-page limit of 1000 projects. The validators now use the v3 Resource Manager SDK `SearchProjects` iterator, which auto-paginates. Customers with thousands of GCP projects see the full list. Required OAuth scope for ADC, Browser OAuth, and WIF was updated from the v1-only `cloudplatformprojects.readonly` to v3-compatible `cloud-platform.read-only`. **Browser OAuth users will see one re-consent prompt** for the new scope on next reconnect.

## Security Updates

### Go Dependencies
- `go.opentelemetry.io/otel` — bumped from `v1.39.0` to `v1.41.0` (with `/metric` and `/trace` in lockstep). Patches GHSA-xxxx (multi-value `baggage` header extraction caused excessive allocations, remote DoS amplification).
- `github.com/Azure/go-ntlmssp` — bumped to `v0.1.1`. Patches NTLM challenge panic on malformed payloads.

### Frontend Dependencies
- `vite` — bumped from `8.0.3` to `8.0.11`. Patches three CVEs: `server.fs.deny` bypass via queries (high), arbitrary file read via dev server WebSocket (high), path traversal in optimized deps `.map` handling (medium).
- `postcss` — bumped to `8.5.14`. Patches XSS via unescaped `</style>` in the CSS stringify output.
- `yaml` — bumped to `1.10.3`. Patches stack overflow on deeply nested YAML collections.

All frontend security pins are enforced via `pnpm.overrides` so transitive consumers (e.g. `@tailwindcss/vite`) stay on the patched versions. The stale `frontend/package-lock.json` (project uses pnpm) was removed; it had drifted out of sync and was triggering duplicate Dependabot alerts.

## Build & CI

### Release Pipeline Consolidation
- **GoReleaser moved to GitLab CI** — new `goreleaser-stable` and `goreleaser-dev` jobs cross-compile darwin_arm64 + linux_amd64 + windows_amd64 (CGO via `mingw-w64`), GPG-sign checksums, upload to GitHub Release, and update the Homebrew tap. The redundant GitHub Actions `release-stable` / `release-dev` jobs have been removed. The single source of truth for release builds is now GitLab. This also eliminates the GitHub self-hosted runner dependency that had been breaking releases.
- Multi-arch Docker images (`linux/amd64` + `linux/arm64`) on `ghcr.io/stefanriegel/uddi-token-calculator` continue to be produced by GitLab CI's `docker-ghcr` job, unchanged.

## Upgrade Notes

### Browser OAuth Users
The OAuth scope change requires a one-time reconsent. Open the GCP credentials wizard, click reconnect, and approve the `cloud-platform.read-only` scope on the consent screen.

### macOS / Linux
```bash
brew upgrade uddi-token-calculator
# or via the install script:
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stefanriegel/UDDI-Token-Calculator/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
```

### Windows
Re-download `uddi-token-calculator_windows_amd64.exe` from the GitHub Release page or rerun `scripts/install.ps1`.

### Docker
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/stefanriegel/uddi-token-calculator:3.4.4
```
